metadata.dcterms:title: IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Framework Supplement — Privacy Consent on FHIR (PCF)
metadata.dcterms:creator: IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Committee
metadata.dcterms:abstract: The Privacy Consent on FHIR (PCF) Profile supports the use of a FHIR Consent resource to capture, discover, and enforce patient privacy consent directives across healthcare actors using the Access Consent [ITI-108] transaction and progressive Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced Consent profiles.

metadata.dcterms:title: IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Framework Supplement — Verifiable Health Links (VHL)
metadata.dcterms:creator: IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Committee
metadata.dcterms:abstract: The Verifiable Health Links (VHL) Profile specifies actors (VHL Holder, VHL Sharer, VHL Receiver, Trust Anchor) and transactions ([ITI-YY1] Submit PKI Material with DID, [ITI-YY2] Retrieve Trust List with DID, [ITI-YY3] Generate VHL, [ITI-YY4] Provide VHL, [ITI-YY5] Retrieve Manifest) for issuing, presenting, verifying, and redeeming cryptographically verifiable links to health documents in a trust-anchor-neutral manner.
